Preflight contract

Modes: shadow, enforced.

Checks: adapter_registration, binary_version, scanner_data, docker_daemon, docker_image, target_start_plan, project_code_consent, sandbox_availability, api_schema_applicability, browser_runtime.

Drift binding: resolvedProfileHash, executionHash, scannerManifestHash, scannerVersionsHash, dockerImagesHash, targetPlanHash, sourceRevisionHash.

In enforced mode, a blocked required check fails before any scanner starts. A blocked optional check is recorded as a coverage gap. shadow mode records the same result without changing admission.
